text.EN: Let's leave it there.

text.EN: We don't need to fight. We're on the same team.

text.EN: It's all right. We can let this one slide.

text.EN: I value our partnership too much to push this.
text.TL: Masyadong mahalaga ang samahan natin para ipagpilitan ito.

text.EN: We'll be okay. Let's take a breather.
text.TL: Magiging maayos tayo. Huminga muna tayo nang malalim.
